niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals (brand awareness vs. performance), budget, geography, creative needs, and whether you want programmatic or platform-direct buys.

To help you pick, answer these two quick questions:
- What’s your primary goal (brand reach, direct response/sales, app installs, or measurement/attribution)?
- Rough budget and geographies (US-only or international)?

If you want a quick shortlist by use case, here are strong options to consider:

- For large-scale brand campaigns and cross-channel strategy
  - Global holding-group media shops: OMD, Mindshare/MediaCom (WPP), Zenith/Starcom (Publicis), UM/Initiative (IPG). Reason: deep media relationships, cross-channel planning and guaranteed scale.

- For programmatic CTV buying and advanced targeting
  - The Trade Desk (DSP) — market-leading programmatic buying capabilities and identity integrations.
  - Amobee, Tremor (Tremor Video) — programmatic CTV specialists with strong execution and access.

- For performance/direct-response CTV
  - MNTN — performance-focused CTV platform/agency hybrid built for measurable direct-response outcomes.
  - Roku Advertising, Amazon Ads — platform-direct buys that can drive performance with first-party data.

- For creative, interactive video, and measurement
  - Innovid — best-in-class for interactive CTV creative and ad delivery across platforms.
  - Measurement partners to look for or request work with: Nielsen, Samba TV, DoubleVerify, IAS for viewability and brand-lift measurement.

- For boutique/specialist needs
  - Independent CTV shops and programmatic trading desks (local/regional specialists) — good if you need hands-on attention or niche inventory.

How to evaluate agencies
- Inventory access (platform-direct vs. programmatic; premium publishers)
- Targeting & identity strategy (how they match/activate audiences)
- Measurement & attribution approach (holdouts, brand lift, conversion tracking)
- Creative capabilities (format expertise for CTV: 6/15/30s, interactive overlays)
- Transparency and fees (media vs. tech fees)
- Fraud prevention and viewability reporting
- Case studies in your vertical and references

Next step
If you tell me your objective, budget range, target markets, and vertical, I can recommend a tailored short list (2–4 agencies/platforms) and specific questions to ask them in RFPs. Which one do you want help with?
